title: Lock down embedding telemetry and retention controls
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description:
Goal: Add configurable telemetry and retention controls for embeddings and reranking endpoints to eliminate inadvertent PII capture in logs, provide per-customer retention policies, and emit structured audit events for compliance.

Scope:
- Add a request-side flag and tenant-level setting to disable request/response text logging for embeddings and reranking.
- Ensure KV cache / prefix caching traces do not include raw user text when logging is enabled.
- Implement a retention engine that tags embedding vectors with retention TTL based on tenant policy and exposes purge events.
- Emit standardized audit events (request received, pii-masked, retention-set, retention-purged) to the central audit stream.
- Console controls: UI toggle + API to view retention timelines and recent purge audit events.

Non-goals:
- Not changing model inference itself (no differential privacy applied).
- Not reworking existing hosted billing telemetry beyond necessary metadata fields.

Acceptance criteria:
- API supports "log_pii": false at request-level that prevents any raw text from being written to storage or logs (verified in staging).
- Tenant setting "default_embedding_retention_days" configurable and honored during writes; vectors are auto-purged and purge produces audit event.
- All embedding/rerank log lines in prod redact or omit raw_text when log_pii is false; verified by log sampling and unit tests.
- Security review completed and signed off before release.

Rollout plan: Canary on dedicated infra for non-production tenants for 48h; gather metrics (latency, error rate, audit event delivery). If stable, enable for 10% of hosted tenants for 72h then full rollout.

Notes on trade-offs:
- Redacting logs reduces debugging signal; we will add structured context (request id, tenant id, prompt hash) to help root-cause without raw text.
- Purge metadata is retained for 90 days by default to satisfy incident investigation needs; raw vectors are zeroed.

Implementation sketch:
1) API & SDK: add optional boolean query param/body field "log_pii" (default: inherit tenant policy). Update SDK docs and typing.
2) Ingestion path: branch to strip raw_text from telemetry buffer before async log write when log_pii==false. Add transform to replace raw_text with prompt_hash and token_count.
3) Retention engine: attach retention_ttl and retention_policy to vector metadata, enqueue purge job. Purge job overwrites vector storage with zeroes and emits audit.retention.purged event including request id and tenant id.
4) Audit events: define schema and add to central event router; events must include actor, tenant, request_id, action, timestamp, and reason.
5) Console: expose retention settings and recent purge events; display warnings if tenant has log_pii=true.

Security considerations:
- Ensure KMS integration when masking/zeroing vectors to avoid accidental snapshot of deleted data.
- Validate that async log sinks (Cloud Logging, S3) receive masked payloads only when appropriate.

Testing:
- Unit tests for transform pipeline redaction.
- Integration test that verifies retention purge zeroes storage and emits event.
- Staging load test for embedding throughput to measure any added latency (target < 2ms p50 increase).
